description_en: Queries the information about data skew for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 获取AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的数据倾斜情况
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instance-data-skew --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --database test --order-by Field:_TableSize,_Type:_Desc --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstanceDataSkew

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

*   **30**
*   **50**
*   **100**

Default value: **30**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. Default value: **1**
parameters.help_zh: 页码，大于0且不超过Integer的最大值，默认值：**1**
parameters.name: page_number
